facts.text: I am looking for inspiration for my dining area.
I have been considering installing string lights or fairy lights to create a more intimate atmosphere for dinner parties.
I am considering installing warm white fairy lights.
I am considering café-style string lights.
I want suggestions on how to hang the lights in a way that creates a balanced look.
I do not want the lights to look cluttered or overwhelming.
I was thinking of placing the fairy lights along the walls or windows to create a cozy ambiance.
I am deciding whether to use adhesive hooks or small nails to hang the fairy lights.
I am thinking of hanging the fairy lights in a swagging pattern along the walls.
I am thinking of starting the swagging pattern from the center point and working outward.
I think I will start by hanging a few lights at the center point of the wall and then work outward in a gentle, sweeping motion.
I think I will vary the height of the lights to add visual interest.
I think I will keep the cord loose to create a relaxed look.
I am considering adding greenery such as eucalyptus or ferns to the walls or windows to add natural elements and texture.
I think I will add eucalyptus to the walls.
I think I will use a trellis or wall planter to keep the eucalyptus tidy.
I think I will weave the fairy lights through the eucalyptus.
I am considering adding candles or lanterns to the tables or shelves to add warmth and ambiance.

keyphrases: fairy lights along walls or windows
candles or lanterns on tables or shelves
